title: eBay high Insertion Fee category blacklist
marketplace_notes: Main is eBay HK seller listing on US (ebay.com); Select B&I $20 Insertion Fees from US Selling fees / Store selling fees apply.
Select B&I $20 cats are excluded from monthly free/zero insertion allocation and charge again on GTC monthly renew.
Motors Parts & Accessories (6028), Automotive Tools & Supplies (34998), Safety & Security Accessories (262266) are NOT in this blacklist (normal insertion).
Heavy Equipment Parts & Accessories (sibling of Heavy Equipment under 257887) is NOT in this blacklist.
Commercial Printing Essentials / parts are NOT in this blacklist (only Commercial Printing Presses 26247 tree).
Sources: eBay Selling fees & Store selling fees (Select B&I row, checked Sep/Oct 2026); eBay Motors vehicle fee tables; live Taxonomy API tree 0 / 100 on 2026-10-18.
